description: Spec 028 refinement (development; spent seeds 361 to choose, 360 to check the choice): the carried prior with its covariance inflated and as a two-part mixture with the standing prior (run10 cprior_variants). Not registered.

man2.what: Annex B targets, two or three periods with gaps

shift.what: shorter legs, smaller turns, more speed changes

choice_rule: Declared before any result: on seed 361, among variants whose Annex B own-turn alone ÷ variant (range) is at least 0.95 and whose carried 95% coverage (4 dof) is at least 0.80 on both splits, the one with the largest Annex B alone ÷ variant (range); ties to the simpler (fewer of inflate != 1, w < 1). Seed 360 then reads the chosen variant only as a check: a gain that holds there (alone ÷ variant above 1 on Annex B and busier, no own-turn harm below 0.9) goes to registration on fresh seeds 362/363; otherwise stop and write up.
